comparator.name: Medicine (Geneeskunde)
comparator.academicYear: Fall 2026 entry, VUmc-Compas: B1 2026–27, B2 2027–28, B3 2028–29
comparator.sourceNotes: VU confirms a three-year Medicine bachelor and the outgoing VUmc-Compas sequence for a Fall 2026 entrant: its first, second and third years are taught for the final time in 2026–27, 2027–28 and 2028–29 respectively. The published programme description identifies first-year body systems, medical expert and professional-development lines, patient cases and a care placement; second-year development, pathology, a general-practice placement and an academic research placement; and a third-year minor, independent bachelor thesis and further clinical disease courses. The prospectus lists course names but does not establish their exact EC or all formal compulsory/choice weights. VU directs readers to the study guide for the OER and full curriculum, but that portal's applicable 2026–27 degree structure was inaccessible to the available retrieval tools. A linked overview is explicitly dated 2023–24 and contains no EC, so it is not used to infer 2026–27 credit weights. No unverified component credits are supplied.

exception.reason: The exact 2026-entry VUmc-Compas component credits, minor credit status and thesis weight cannot be verified from accessible current official VU sources. A complete 180-EC route would require guessed weights, so a canonical comparison cannot be made yet. Independently, the identified patient-centred clinical training, examination and diagnosis, professional practice and care/general-practice placements cannot be represented as a medical bachelor by UCR's academic biomedical and health courses.
exception.curriculumContext: The 2026-entry cohort can progress through the last full B1, B2 and B3 VUmc-Compas offerings in successive years before VUMED360 replaces them; this transition must not be mistaken for a single new-curriculum route. VU's current OER guidance points to the study guide for exact formal requirements. The public pages establish curricular themes and placements, but not a defensible credit-bearing 180-EC component list. Resolve the applicable official 2026–27 OER/study-guide credits before revisiting the comparator.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 course rows of current GitHub main data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx, including the outline-derived profile, description, topics, methods, prerequisites and six planned cohort terms. HCBGATE101 Foundation of Life, Health & Biomedicine, HCBLIFE211 Molecular Cell Biology, HCBLIFE214 Life Science Laboratory, HCBBIOM311 Pharmacology and HCBBIOM313 Mechanisms of Disease support biological and disease study. No UCR course provides the integrated patient-facing medical-expert sequence, clinical examination and diagnosis, supervised care and general-practice placements, or clinical professional qualification that defines Medicine. These courses are relevant neighbouring study, not substitutes for clinical Medicine.
